statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail risk is 18% (low) on an orderly two-way overnight Nasdaq-100 path, while Stress of 58% (elevated) reflects Treasury yields at 19-year highs and a live October Fed hike debate.
recommendation: Tail remains below the WATCH threshold in the current hour. The concentrated whipsaw window is 12:15-14:45 UTC, spanning August durable goods orders at 12:30 UTC, the U.S. cash open at 13:30 UTC and the final Michigan sentiment reading at 14:00 UTC. CME equity index futures close for the week at 21:00 UTC and reopen at 22:00 UTC on Sunday.
headline: Balanced overnight Nasdaq-100 path holds Tail low while a 19-year-high bond rout keeps Stress elevated
body: NQ December futures trade near 30,786, up about 0.06%, inside a narrow overnight band of 30,679.00-30,814.50, roughly 0.44% wide. The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed the 24 September session at 30,478.86, up 0.03%, after a two-way 30,204.16-30,529.35 range that retraced and recovered rather than extending in one direction. That is the decisive Tail evidence: retracements are occurring, no session extreme is being held, and there is no repeated extension after failed pullbacks. The macro backdrop is far more stressed than the price path. The 10-year Treasury yield sits near 5.19% and the 30-year near its highest since 2004, after a multi-day rout driven by strong S&P Global activity surveys, hawkish Federal Reserve commentary and weak five-year auction demand; futures markets price better than 70% odds of an additional October rate increase. Oil remains elevated, with WTI near 93.09 dollars and Brent near 105.66 dollars, although both eased on reporting of a possible phased U.S.-Iran arrangement affecting the Strait of Hormuz. Against that, VIX closed at 15.67 and megacap and semiconductor performance is rotational rather than aligned, with strength in Meta and Alphabet offsetting weakness in Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia and Broadcom. Yields at 19-year highs coexisting with low equity volatility is a genuine cross-asset conflict, which by contract raises Stress and caps Confidence without mechanically raising Tail. Geopolitics is currently de-escalating: the U.S.-China trade truce was extended to 10 January 2027 around the Trump-Xi state visit. The shared Finviz context file was 148 minutes old at assessment time and reported partial collection with its futures and calendar sections unavailable, so it was treated as stale supporting context only and all current levels were taken from independent primary sources.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 published Claude assessments held Tail between 17% and 25%, touching the block threshold once at 09:00 UTC on 24 September during a trend-down European morning before decaying through the U.S. session. Stress stayed elevated in a 50-59% band throughout, reflecting the ongoing bond repricing, and Confidence held between 85% and 88%. The overnight sequence from 20:00 UTC onward settled into low-Tail, normal-mode readings as the price path became balanced.
outlookSummary: The base case is continued balanced rotation through the European session, with Tail touching the WATCH band around the European cash open on gap risk rather than observed structure. Risk concentrates between 12:15 and 14:45 UTC, where August durable goods orders, the U.S. cash open and the final Michigan sentiment reading fall in sequence into a market pricing better than 70% odds of an October rate increase; the mode is expected to turn event/whipsaw there, with Tail peaking at 24% and remaining inside WATCH. Escalation above the block threshold would require observed opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks and repeated extension after failed retracements. A secondary lift is expected into the 19:00 UTC Treasury cash close and equity power hour on Friday weekend squaring. CME equity index futures then close for the week at 21:00 UTC, so the final seven slots carry no tradeable price path: Tail falls sharply, residual Stress represents weekend gap exposure only, and Confidence steps down because no live evidence is observable until the 22:00 UTC Sunday reopen.
